file_insights.purpose: Django views for managing purchase order receiving process
key_components: receiving_list - paginated list with search and filtering
receiving_detail - detailed view of single receiving
receiving_create - create new receiving with items
receiving_item_add - add items to existing receiving
receiving_approve - approve receiving and create stock movements
dependencies: Warehouse, StockMovement models from inventory app

patterns_discovered.description: Consistent use of select_related() and prefetch_related() for database efficiency
All POST endpoints return JsonResponse with success/error status and messages
examples: Consistent structure with 'success' boolean and 'message' string
patterns_discovered.benefit: Standardized API responses for frontend AJAX calls

patterns_discovered.description: All data modifications include created_by and updated_by user tracking
patterns_discovered.benefit: Maintains complete audit history of changes

patterns_discovered.description: Operations validated against receiving status before execution
examples: status not in ['PENDING', 'INSPECTING'] checks before editing
status not in ['PENDING', 'INSPECTING'] checks before approval

patterns_discovered.description: Approval process updates multiple related entities
examples: Updates receiving status, order item received_quantity, purchase order status
patterns_discovered.benefit: Maintains data consistency across related records

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Silent JSON parsing failure in receiving_create
gotchas_discovered.issue: try-except block catches JSONDecodeError and KeyError but silently passes without validation
gotchas_discovered.risk: Receiving created without items will not notify user of parsing failure
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Return error response instead of silent pass, or validate items before creation

gotchas_discovered.issue: Decimal(str(quantity_received)) may fail with non-numeric strings
gotchas_discovered.risk: Unhandled exception if user provides invalid quantity format
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Add explicit validation for numeric input before Decimal conversion

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Missing error handling for StockMovement creation
gotchas_discovered.issue: StockMovement.objects.create() inside loop not wrapped in try-except
gotchas_discovered.risk: Single failed movement creation would rollback entire approval
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Either validate all movements before creation or wrap in database transaction

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Potential data inconsistency in order status update
gotchas_discovered.issue: Order status changed to RECEIVED only if all items are fully received, but no check for partial items
gotchas_discovered.risk: Order could be marked PARTIAL when it should be RECEIVED or vice versa
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Add explicit validation of all items' received status before status determination

gotchas_discovered.issue: json.loads(request.body) assumes request.body is valid JSON without content-type validation
gotchas_discovered.risk: JSONDecodeError if client sends non-JSON POST data
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Check Content-Type header and add explicit error handling for JSON parsing

approach_outcome.code_quality: Good structure with consistent patterns, but missing some error handling edge cases
approach_outcome.test_coverage: No test files included in this subtask
approach_outcome.integration_readiness: Views are ready for template integration and frontend development

recommendations.recommendation: Add transaction.atomic() decorator to receiving_approve() to ensure all-or-nothing updates across Receiving, ReceivingItem, PurchaseOrder, and StockMovement models
Implement explicit validation for Decimal/numeric inputs with user-friendly error messages instead of silent failures
Add Content-Type validation in receiving_reject() before JSON parsing, or use request.POST for form data consistency
Add logging for critical operations (approval, rejection, stock movements) for audit and debugging purposes
Add @require_http_methods decorator to receiving_list, receiving_detail, and receiving_create GET methods for consistency
Consider caching stats in receiving_list view as they query entire Receiving table on each request
Extract common validation logic (status checks) into helper functions to reduce duplication across endpoints
